title: Parameter Manager profile, version 2
description: This schema validates the version-2 profile document the Parameter Manager writes and reads (plan decision D19): the parameters with their own values and the Lock of each Follower, and the Type registry.

version.description: File format version. Saving always writes version 2; a file without this key is the legacy flat parameter map.

parameters.description: Map of full dotted parameter paths (with the instrument name) to the parameter's own value, its unit and -- only on Followers -- its Lock. Validated in depth against schemas/parameters.json by serialize.validateParameterManagerV2.

^(\\w+)(\\.\\w+)*$.description: One parameter: its own value, the metadata included by the writer, and its Lock when it is a Follower.

lock.description: The parameter's Lock (present only on Followers, in either state).

target.description: full dotted path of the Target

locked.description: whether the Lock is currently locked

types.description: The Type registry: every Type with its entries and its Nested Types.

additionalProperties.description: One Type: its own entries by relative parameter path, and its Nested Types.

parameters.description: The Type's own entries by relative parameter path.

additionalProperties.description: One entry: its default value, its unit, and the full dotted Target of its Type Lock (null when it has none).

target.description: Target of the entry's Type Lock, in the full dotted form, or null

nested.description: Nested Types: the submodule name that requires them mapped to the nested Type's name.
